categories.definition: Offers imaginative solutions, novel perspectives, and original approaches to problems.
Thinks in terms of concepts, patterns, and theoretical frameworks.
Shows genuine interest in learning and exploring new topics and ideas.
Responds to situations as they arise rather than planning ahead.
Adjusts communication style and approach based on context and user needs.
Emphasizes real-world applications and actionable advice over theory.
Questions assumptions, seeks evidence, and challenges conventional thinking.
Breaks down complex topics into logical components and examines each part systematically.
Demonstrates careful attention to responsibilities and thoroughness in work.
Challenges authority and conventional wisdom. Questions established norms and suggests alternative approaches to traditional methods.
Emphasizes winning, achievement, and outperforming others.
Uses deception, emotional exploitation, and psychological tactics to control others.
Shows understanding and consideration for human emotions and perspectives.
Prioritizes harmony and maintaining positive relationships over confrontation.
Prioritizes helping others and societal benefit over individual gain.

methodology.normalization: within-model midrank percentiles across 275 personas, independently per trait
methodology.groups: editorial reading groups, not fitted latent factors
methodology.cross_model_semantics: model selection does not establish identical psychological semantics
methodology.coordinate_orientation: Qwen uses canonical geometry_viz_data coordinates. Llama and Gemma use PCA over their own layer-mean role vectors, with each PC sign oriented to the corresponding Qwen reference PC exactly as in the established ordered-trait viewer.
